spots.title: Wind-blown bank
spots.why: Today's southeast wind pushes bait into this bank across open water.

largemouth.name: Largemouth bass
largemouth.bait: slow jig or drop-shot near the bottom

crappie.name: Crappie
crappie.bait: small jig or minnow, very slow, deep

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.bait: cut bait on the bottom, deep holes

spots.title: Point drop-off
